ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - CrackMapExec Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: This rule detect common flag combinations used by CrackMapExec in order to detect its use even if the binary has been replaced.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\crackmapexec\\\.exe$") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-M\\ pe\\_inject\\ .*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-local\\-auth.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-x\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-local\\-auth.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-H\\ \\'NTHASH\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ mssql\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-M\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-d\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ smb\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-H\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-M\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-o\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ smb\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-local\\-auth.*"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-local\\-auth.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 10\\\..*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 192\\\.168\\\..*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/24\\ .*")))
